items.passageEn: Last weekend, I visited a history museum about an old town in a faraway country. The town had a glorious past. The museum showed an old sword and the metal star that the town's first sheriff wore on his shirt. The sheriff's job was to keep the town safe. Every night, he led a patrol around the streets. One famous story was about the mayor's horse, which ran away; the sheriff found it after three days. The museum also explained how people got citizenship in the past: they needed a registration paper from the town office. Today, people can't legally carry a sword in the streets.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我參觀了一座歷史博物館，介紹遠方國家的一個古老小鎮。那個小鎮有過一段光榮的歷史。博物館展示了一把古老的劍，還有小鎮第一任警長別在襯衫上的星形警徽。警長的工作是保護小鎮的安全。每天晚上，他都會帶著巡邏隊在街上巡邏。有個著名的故事講的是鎮長的馬跑掉了，警長三天後就找到了牠。博物館也說明了過去人們如何取得公民身分：他們需要鎮公所發的登記文件。如今，人們不能合法地在街上帶劍。

options: 帶著巡邏隊在街上巡邏

questions.questionZh: 過去人們要怎麼取得公民身分？
options: 必須在警長面前用劍比武獲勝
需要鎮公所發的登記文件
